'''Eetoa Ro''' was a teenage [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sometime after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he helped arrange passage off-planet for the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], [[Resh (Sullustan)|Resh]].
